text:
Liam Park: Hi all 1 just unpacked my loaner MBP and on first boot it asks for a FileVault recovery key. My account login isn't letting me in. macOS Ventura 13.6, serial C02XXXX. How do I get the recovery key?

rachel-it: Hey Liam 1 welcome! That means the machine is FileVault enabled and the user's FV key isn't associated with the local account yet. We'll pull the escrowed key from Kandji/device inventory. Can you confirm the serial and the asset tag (on the box)?

Liam Park: Serial is C02X1Y2Z3, asset tag 1029-LRB.

julia-it-ops: Thanks. I'll open a support action to retrieve the escrowed key. @people-ops we'll need approval to disclose the recovery key to the new hire for device unlock. Tagging @security-ops for policy check.

people-ops: Approve for user unlock only. Please record the release and rotate the device keys afterwards.

kandji-bot: Found device record for C02X1Y2Z3. FileVault escrow: present. Request queued for admin retrieval.

security-ops: Reminder: do NOT send keys over email or public chat. Use ephemeral secure channel (1-hour vault link) or call and read the key. Also verify user identity (okta, ID).

julia-it-ops: Liam 1 can you confirm you completed Okta sign-up and your id badge arrived? We need to validate before releasing key.

Liam Park: Okta setup completed (I can log in), badge is pending delivery today. I can do a video call with a staff ID if needed.

rachel-it: Since Okta is good, we can do ephemeral vault link. Julia will generate a secure 1-hour link with the key and post it to you. Once you unlock, we'll SSH in and add your local user to FileVault so you won't need the key again.

julia-it-ops: Generated vault link (expires in 60m). Sending to Liam via direct message (secure).

kandji-bot: Audit log: FileVault recovery key accessed by julia-it-ops for device C02X1Y2Z3 at 2026-03-24T09:14:07Z.

Liam Park: Got the link and the key, unlocked the Mac, booted fine. Thanks.

rachel-it: Next step: we'll add your user to FV so the key isn't needed on next reboot. Please run this in Terminal (we'll remote if you prefer):

```
sudo fdesetup add -usertoadd "liam.park@redwood.com"
```
It will prompt for your local password and add the user to allowed FV users.

Liam Park: Running it now... it asked for password and returned "User added to FileVault". Rebooted and login worked without key.

security-ops: Confirmed device status: FV enabled, user liam.park is authorized. We'll rotate the escrow key and update Kandji record to reflect release.

julia-it-ops: Rotation scheduled and applied. Kandji updated.

people-ops: Noted for onboarding record. Liam welcome again! Ping #help if anything else during first week.

Liam Park: Thanks everyone 1 that was fast and helpful.
